info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Transactions Retrieval API
info.description: The Financial Transactions Retrieval API enables users to securely access and retrieve detailed information regarding past and current financial transactions. This API primarily serves banking institutions and financial services providers seeking to monitor payment activities and transaction histories. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can enhance customer experiences with timely data retrieval, ensuring clients have up-to-date information at their fingertips. Typical use cases include auditing transactions, generating financial reports, and facilitating customer inquiries.
